import json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
value=json.load(sys.stdin)
with Path('/mnt/DATA/tmp/oda-native-preferences-65qff4t1/status-events.jsonl').open("a") as stream:
 stream.write(json.dumps({"recorded_at":time.monotonic(),"phase":sys.argv[1],"value":value})+"\n")
print("ODA_STATUS_"+sys.argv[1])
